# Prenuvo (whole-body MRI proactive-health membership)

URL: https://prenuvo.com/

## Type system
- Display: `Gilroy, Arial, sans-serif` — H1 64px/600, H2 32px/600. A
  rounded-geometric grotesk at semi-bold weight, giving headlines real
  visual weight without a serif.
- Body: `Lato, sans-serif` at 12px/400 — a smaller, humanist body face for
  captions and UI labels.
- No serif, no mono.

## Color system
- bg: white `#FFFFFF` for content sections.
- hero surface: near-black `#000000` transitioning into deep teal
  `#003333` via a soft radial gradient — a distinctive
  black-to-forest-teal hero treatment rather than a flat dark or flat
  light hero.
- accent: bright mint-green `#4FE88C` and mid-teal `#27896C` — used for
  primary CTA buttons ("Book your scan") and data-highlight moments (e.g.
  glowing edges on imagery).
- Secondary light surface: `#F1F4F5` for content bands beneath the hero.

## Layout & grid
- Full-bleed dark hero (black fading to teal radial glow) with warm,
  candid lifestyle photography of real couples/individuals (not clinical
  stock) overlaid — headline "See the full picture of your health. Year
  after year." plus pricing-anchor subhead ("starting at $1,199").
- Below the dark hero, alternating full-bleed photographic bands: an
  athletic action shot (surfing), a macro red-blood-cell photograph, and a
  patient portrait — each treated as its own large, editorial section
  rather than being cropped into a grid.
- Clinician credential section uses a dense 7-up headshot grid with names
  and titles directly beneath a "This is a clinical team with real
  impact" statement.

## Sections (order observed)
1. Full-bleed dark-to-teal gradient hero, lifestyle couple photo, pricing
   subhead, dual CTA (Book your scan / See pricing)
2. "Whole Body Scan" feature callout — small copy block over the fading
   hero, "1.3 billion data points across every organ system"
3. "Deeper imaging & AI insights" — full-bleed surfing action photo with
   overlaid feature copy (Advanced Body Composition Analysis, Advanced
   Heart Health Score)
4. "A deeper look at your health with 80+ biomarkers" — full-bleed macro
   red-blood-cell photography
5. "Trusted by more than 170,000 patients" — patient portrait + video
   testimonial quote ("I thought it was 100% worth it")
6. "This is a clinical team with real impact" — 7-up clinician headshot
   grid (named, credentialed) + partner/institution logos (Cleveland
   Clinic-style trust marks) + press logos (Forbes, Vogue, NYT, LA Times,
   Town & Country)
7. "Scan. Review. Track. Repeat." — process explainer
8. "A personalized path to better health starts here" — 3-up plan cards
   (Executive / Comprehensive / Core) on dark teal-gradient cards
9. Footer with newsletter signup and a final warm portrait photo

## Components/signature
- The black-to-teal radial gradient hero treatment, repeated on the
  plan-selection cards later in the page, is the site's visual signature —
  it reads as "night sky meets deep ocean" and ties the whole page
  together without needing a repeated icon or illustration system.
- Real, warm, candid photography (athletes, couples, patients) rather than
  clinical or studio photography — the strongest "warm/human" execution in
  the dark-hero portion of the dataset, bridging the dark-tech and
  warm-human poles.

## Motion/interactions
- Full-bleed photo/gradient transitions between sections use large soft
  curved dividers (visible as rounded section boundaries in the
  screenshot) rather than hard rectangular breaks — a distinctive framing
  device repeated at every major section boundary.

## Biomarker/trust presentation
- "1.3 billion data points" and "80+ biomarkers" are stated as headline
  numbers without a chart or table — data volume itself is the trust
  claim, not a visualized score.
- Clinician trust is unusually strong: a 7-person named/credentialed
  headshot grid plus recognizable institutional partner logos, combined
  with press logos (Forbes, Vogue, NYT) — the most credential-dense trust
  section in the dataset outside of Function Health's advisory board.
- Patient testimonial video with a direct quote functions as the primary
  emotional trust device, paired with a large "170,000 patients" stat.

## What works
- The soft curved section dividers plus a consistent black-to-teal
  gradient motif give a long, content-heavy page a strong sense of visual
  continuity without needing repeated iconography.
- Combining warm candid photography with a dark, premium-tech gradient
  hero proves the "dark/high-tech" and "warm/human" poles can be blended
  rather than treated as strictly opposite directions.

## Avoid
- The dark hero photography needs a strong scrim/gradient to keep white
  headline text legible — don't drop the black-to-teal overlay if reusing
  candid photography under text.
- A 7-person credential grid is data-dense; keep headshots small and
  uniform (as done here) or it will overwhelm the page's otherwise
  generous pacing.

## How to apply
- Use a black-to-brand-colour radial gradient (not flat black) for a dark
  hero to keep it feeling premium rather than heavy, and repeat that exact
  gradient on pricing/plan cards later in the page to tie the composition
  together.
- Pair warm candid photography with credential-dense trust sections
  (named clinicians + institutional partner logos + press logos) to
  balance approachability with clinical authority in a single page.
